fieldMarks: Medium cottontail, total length about 38 cm and roughly 0.8-1 kg; females slightly larger than males.
Long ears (about 7 cm) and hind feet about 9 cm.
behavior: Most active in early morning and evening, spending the rest of the day under cover.
Not gregarious; home range generally about 3 ha (8 acres).
When startled it freezes or runs for cover in a zig-zag at about 24 km/h; can swim and climb brush piles.
Eats almost exclusively grasses, plus some fruit, nuts and vegetables.
habitat: Mainly arid regions, but also woodland and grassland from sea level to about 1,800 m; shelters in heavy brush, brambles or holes.
range: Southwestern North America from northern Montana south to central Mexico and west to the Pacific coast.
